ruling: The brief's supply-cliff timing verdict was built on a filing-date artifact (red's kill, clean): the 11.1M SciTec resale shares have been saleable since 2025-12-19 (the 8/11 424B3 is the 7th routine supplement), and the insider overhang EXECUTED in June at $48 (8M secondary). What actually bars the name (blue, adopted): ~$82M/qtr OCF burn (+~$20M/qtr capex) against $635M cash+STI dates a required equity raise ~late-2027 — INSIDE any holding horizon — at 8.7x guide-mid sales and 20.3% GM, where +50% requires multiple re-rating to ~35x gross profit, not delivery. Marketed '$1.5B record backlog' is 2.7x the FILED RPO of $563.7M (multi-venue fire); transcript's '95% of H2 booked' is contradicted by the guide needing ~100% of the ENTIRE twelve-month RPO in six months. Red's 'we are the street = no edge' NARROWED: FY26 consensus is management's own guide transcribed (0.8% gap, circular) — the honest statement is no FY26-revenue divergence; the unguided FY27/GM/dilution lines were never compared.
